```{r setup, include=FALSE}


library(worldfootballR)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)

```


```{r}
players <- read_excel("~/Desktop/stat/all_player_DEU.xlsx")

df <- tm_player_market_values(country_name = "Germany", start_year = 2024)

# Clean player name column
players <- players %>%
  mutate(PlayerNameClean = tolower(str_trim(Player)))
```

```{r}
mv_esp_2023 <- tm_player_market_values(
  country_name = "France",
  start_year   = 2024
)

# Keep useful columns
mv_esp_2023_clean <- mv_esp_2023 %>%
  mutate(PlayerNameClean = tolower(str_trim(player_name))) %>%
  select(
    PlayerNameClean,
    MarketValue = player_market_value_euro,
    Club = squad,
    League = comp_name
  )
```


```{r}
players_with_VALUE <- players %>%
  left_join(mv_esp_2023_clean, by = "PlayerNameClean")

# --- Step 4: Save output file ---
write_xlsx(players_with_VALUE, "players_with_market_value_DEU.xlsx")
```
